name: What are the signs I need a new roof?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs I need a new roof?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for curled/missing shingles, granule loss in gutters, interior leaks or stains, sagging roof deck, or age (20-30 years for asphalt shingles). Get a professional inspection before visible ceiling damage.
